summary: Frontend-only validation of the new dynamic recipient 'Usuario Implementador' (project_implementer) across both configuration submodules — Otras Acciones and SLA de Proyectos. Both screens correctly expose the new option (with 🛠️ icon and project_implementer value), show the expected placeholder text '— implementador asignado al proyecto —' in the recipient column, and persist successfully on save (success toasts received in both flows, recipient count badge updated on SLA card to '1 dest.'). Cleanup performed on SLA action sla_warning_en_gestion: row removed and switch turned off (now shows 'Desactivada'), so no real emails will fire from cron.

issues: Non-blocking React hydration warning in console: <tr> inside <span> / <span> inside <tbody> caused by a wrapping span with style={display:'contents'} injected by an external editor tracker (data-ve-dynamic). Does not affect functionality but pollutes console (pre-existing, not introduced by this feature).

critical_code_review_comments: OtherActionsConfig.jsx L19: when switching type from 'user' to a dynamic type (project_implementer / session_user / session_executive), user_id is correctly nulled. ✅
ProjectSlaConfig.jsx L20: same correct user_id reset on type change. ✅
Both files share near-identical RecipientRow/ActionCard logic — candidate for extraction into a shared component to reduce duplication (~150 LOC duplicated). Minor, not blocking.
seed_data_creation: None. Temporarily added 1 SLA recipient + 1 Other-Actions recipient for save validation; SLA row REMOVED and action DEACTIVATED on cleanup. Other-Actions (new_product_phase_change) save remains persisted with the implementer recipient (this action does NOT fire emails from cron — it is event-triggered on phase change, no test-data project will trigger it). If main agent wants pristine state, delete the row via UI on /settings/other-actions → new_product_phase_change.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature fully validated end-to-end via Playwright. Verified: (1) option '🛠️ Usuario Implementador' is rendered as 4th item in OA dropdown contiguous to 'Ejecutivo generador' and as 2nd item in SLA dropdown contiguous to '⚡ Generador del Proyecto'. (2) Selecting it shows italic placeholder '— implementador asignado al proyecto —' in column 2. (3) Save returns HTTP 200 with toast 'Configuración guardada' (OA) / 'Acción guardada' (SLA). (4) After SLA save, the badge '1 dest.' is visible confirming persistence. (5) Cleanup left SLA action sla_warning_en_gestion as 'Desactivada' with 0 recipients.
